title: Permanent Resident
docsTitle: Required Documents for Permanent Residence Application
tips:
・Permanent Resident status allows **indefinite stay in Japan** with most rights of Japanese citizens except voting

・Requires **10+ years of continuous residence** (or shorter for spouses/children of Japanese/PR holders)

・Check the latest application requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

・Must demonstrate **good conduct, financial stability, and contribution to Japan**

・**Points-based system** available for highly skilled professionals to reduce waiting period
